text:
DECISION: Skip InstantX depth-upscaler and SD3.5 face-refiner—both miss EXCAVA’s motion blur root cause; instead, test a temporal-sharpness model (e.g., VRT or RVRT) on the worst 10% face frames to restore motion consistency.

Result must deliver: a 0.5%+ fidelity gain on motion-blurred faces.
Owner: Torque.
